text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Osaka Hai. Super Creek is bursting with energy from doing her best for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross drops by to cheer her on by saying she's looking forward to their contest at the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek heads to the track to make Tamamo Cross proud.
